newsitem.title: USA: Whirlpool to redeem zero coupon notes.
newsitem.headline: Whirlpool to redeem zero coupon notes.

text.p: Whirlpool Corp said on Friday that it is redeemng its zero coupon subordinated notes due 2011 on January 31, 1997.

The company said it is redeeming them at a price of $374.26 per $1,000 principal amount of the notes. The redemption price equals $252.57 as the issue price plus $121.69 as the accrued original issue discount at seven percent.
Noteholders have the option to convert the debt into common stock at a price of 7.237 shares per $1,000 in principal prior to the redemption date, Whirlpool said.
